- **verified** (9): checked against an exact or independent reference by a named test
- **partial** (24): works on the named fixtures, with known gaps
- **unverified** (1): built, not yet checked
- **open** (0): not built

The blocks off the rings then go through the layout optimisation (block::layout, after Sauer & Morsbach 2023): vertices slide along the box or move freely, interior edges bend by two Hermite modes, Tanh/Geometric end spacings scale, minimising the face non-orthogonality and growth of the TFI grid by a pattern search (Hooke & Jeeves 1961); the result's layout entry reports before and after. A check refuses a TFI grid that still folds, naming the gap to change. Nine cases (research/block-layout-optimisation.md): max non-orthogonality 76-89° (58-240 cells over 70°, two cases refused) became 47.4-68.2° with no cell over 70° and no fold, at 0.5-2.5 s per template. Slat 25° (gap 0.05, overlap -0.04), flap 30° (gap 0.03, overlap -0.02), 64 surface cells: TFI 54.72°/14.46° max/mean, elliptic 54.85°/14.23° converged in 1,310 sweeps (34 s; was 40,000 sweeps, 6 min), wall angle max/mean 44.9°/4.6°.
